data.current_description:
Maps a username (the text that the user logs in with to Internet Banking / consent flow) to an User ID. This can represent some kind of internet banking number, email or phone number. As the username can often be an email or phone number, HaaS cannot rely on the username being consistent over the lifetime of the grant. This call is for converting that username to an ID that HaaS can use to look up details about the user over the lifetime of grant without having to keep up to date with username changes if the user changes their phone number or email.
This functionality is used to convert a user identifier to a principal identifier within HaaS Admin.

This operation is used in HaaS Admin to map user identifiers to principal identifiers and enables consistent user lookups across consent grant lifecycles.
